metadata.title: Meta Faces U.K. Antitrust Probe Over AI Publisher Content Terms - WSJ

content.text:
Meta META 1.96%increase; up pointing triangle Platforms faces an investigation from the U.K.’s competition regulator over potential new business terms that would allow the company to collect content from publishers to power its own products such as artificial intelligence tools.
The Competition and Markets Authority said Friday that Meta’s potential terms change could unfairly harm publishers and advertisers that use its popular social media platforms.
